title: 2D Pose Graph Optimization (Gauss-Newton, SE2)
hints: Residual: e = [R_zᵀ(R_iᵀ(t_j − t_i) − t_z) ; wrap(θ_j − θ_i − θ_z)]. Wrap the angle. Without it, the loop closure at ±π explodes.
Jacobians (Grisetti tutorial): A = ∂e/∂x_i = [[−R_zᵀR_iᵀ, R_zᵀ (dR_iᵀ/dθ_i)(t_j − t_i)], [0 0, −1]], B = ∂e/∂x_j = [[R_zᵀR_iᵀ, 0], [0 0, 1]].
Dense H (3N×3N) and b. Per edge: H_ii += AᵀΩA, H_ij += AᵀΩB, H_ji += BᵀΩA, H_jj += BᵀΩB, b_i += AᵀΩe, b_j += BᵀΩe. Solve HΔ = −b.
Gauge: solve only for poses 1..N−1, i.e. H.bottomRightCorner(3N−3, 3N−3).ldlt().solve(−b.tail(3N−3)). Apply Δ, wrap θ, stop when ‖Δ‖ < 1e-9.
